مُدَجِّجٌ and مُدَجَّجٌ A man completely armed: (S, * K, * TA:) and so A 'Obeyd explains ↓ مُدَجْدَجٌ : he is so called because he walks slowly by reason of the weight of his arms; or because he covers himself therewith, from دَجَّجَتِ السَّمَآءُ. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also (assumed tropical:) The hedgehog; syn. قُنْفُذٌ: (ISd, K:) or a large قُنْفُذٌ: (TA:) app. so called because of its spines. (ISd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
